children: American Rebel entered into a Note Exchange Agreement with Streeterville to reduce debt through a debt-for-equity swap. The company partitioned a new $93,000 secured promissory note from its June 2025 note and immediately exchanged it for 697,674 common shares. The original note’s outstanding balance was reduced by the partitioned amount. Management expects the transaction to strengthen the balance sheet and improve financial flexibility.
